visible.message:
If I assign a value above max_value to a number_input through Session State, the widget silently takes it and gets stuck in an editing state. Code:

value = st.number_input('A', min_value=1, max_value=5, key='A')
def set_too_big():
    st.session_state.A = 10
st.button('Too big', on_click=set_too_big)

I would expect a Python error. I have not supplied my version.

agent_script.user_draft: Since Streamlit 1.44.0, st.slider and st.number_input raise an error when assigned a value beyond the declared minimum or maximum. If you are on an older release, upgrading gives you that error instead of the silent invalid value.
agent_script.maintainer_summary: 1.44.0 adds the range error; version unknown.
